# LegalVault

> LegalVault is an online contract library and practice management platform for
> businesses: ready-to-execute contract templates, practical contracting guidance, and
> step-by-step tools to understand, negotiate, and conclude agreements, plus e-signatures
> and workflow tracking. South African B2B SaaS; subscriptions are invoiced directly, not
> processed in-app.

[PLACEHOLDER] Replace https://legalvault.example.com below with the real production domain
before launch (see frontend/src/constants/site.ts).

## Pages

- [Home](https://legalvault.example.com/): product overview, about, blog, and contact
  sections all on one page.
- [Request access](https://legalvault.example.com/register): firms request access here; organizations are set up by the LegalVault team, not self-registered.
